init_FullyShardLosslessDistributor: create a FullyShardLosslessDistributor instance with a param_group dict and optional runtime config for distributed Shampoo optimization
get_params_or_grads: get assigned full parameters or gradients from the param_group using the _get_params_or_grads helper method
update_params: update model parameters using blocked search directions and redistribute across shards with ROUND_ROBIN or REPLICATE strategy
construct_local_block_info_list: construct a local block info list from the param_group by filtering assigned parameters with nonzero elements
refresh_assigned_full_params: refresh cached full parameter tensors after loading a checkpoint to prevent the optimizer from using stale values
